title: Hexliteral Manifest Schema
description: Configuration file for Hexliteral C++ byte array builds.

outputBoundary.description: Number of hexadecimal bytes per line in the generated array.

cppDeclare.description: Whether to wrap the array in a C++ declaration (e.g., const uint8_t name[] = { ... }).

emitSizeMacro.description: Whether to automatically emit a macro defining the array size.

indentSpaces.description: Number of spaces for indenting the hex array lines.

headerComment.description: Whether to emit an auto-generated comment block at the top of the file.

builds.description: List of build tasks to aggregate multiple assets into C++ header files.

out.description: Relative path to the output C++ header file.

backup.description: If true, creates a backup (~) of the existing output file before overwriting.

guard.description: Optional include guard macro string (e.g., ASSETS_H).

using.description: Array of namespaces for using directives.

items.description: List of assets to process and bundle into this output file.

src.description: Relative path to the source web asset file.

var.description: C++ variable name for the generated array.

macro.description: Optional macro name to wrap the asset in a conditional compile block.

emitSizeMacro.description: Asset-level override for the global emitSizeMacro setting.
